mechanism: Valsartan may reduce the antihypertensive efficacy of carbidopa-levodopa through direct vasodilation counteraction, and levodopa can cause orthostatic hypotension which may be additive with valsartan's blood pressure-lowering effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely in patients receiving both medications; adjust valsartan or levodopa dosing as needed based on blood pressure response and clinical status.
